decisions.reason: The mismatch-description process does not alter responsibility for producing text cards.
The source changes the process for specifying storyboard mismatches, not the requirement that sets remain visually distinct.
The source does not change the established pair count, character pairing, or framing progression.
The storyboard-mismatch specification process does not change the set-image quality rules or permitted quality-improvement methods.
The source does not establish that the energy-blast behavior differs from the storyboard or modify its substantive specification.
The source does not change the deferred opening aerial shot or establish that it is a storyboard mismatch.
The source does not modify the requirement for stylistic continuity across set imagery.
The source does not alter the required Kestrel bridge removals or retained bridge configuration.
The mismatch-description process does not affect the video's 9:16 vertical output format.
